note: Dots (小红书 Dots Studio, dots.ai) model catalog — free public beta. Edit this file and the Fetch Models button in 10Router will pull the latest list. Optional per-model capability fields: vision (bool), reasoning (bool), contextWindow (int), maxOutput (int), thinkingFormat (string). Source: https://dots.ai/platform/docs. Thinking is enabled by default and toggled via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.
